description: Option Alpha's optimizer theme for breakout calls (calm, risk-on days; in-sample on OA's 19 positive runs: IV rank <= ~40 in 8, open change 0 to +0.75% in 4, VIX change <= ~1% in 4), pre-registered 2026-10-31 and tested on the period OA never saw (NOT_SEEN_BY_OA, 2024-08-01..2025-10-29). SPY, QQQ, IWM each on its own, ORB60 calls and puts, first breakout only, signal bars finishing by 12:00, desk fills, base cost (2% half-spread), all out 15:25, fixed stop/target as % of the debit: T1's 50/100 with the 0.50-delta contract (d45-60t50; OA's re-run OA-S1-088 on Nov 2025-Jun 2026: 75 trades, PF 1.55) and the Stage-1 survivor 20/60 with d40-55t45. Filters (every run with a filter has its unfiltered twin here; each filter is also tested against random day-skips): (1) vixy_pctl_le40, IV-rank proxy: VIXY percentile <= 40% (the share of the 252 split-adjusted daily VIXY closes ending at the prior session's close that are at or below that close; the window skips the locked months Feb-Jul 2024, which are never pulled, so early dates reach back into 2023; VIXY's decay biases this proxy low); (2) vixy_not_rising: VIXY's last finished 1-minute close at the decision <= its prior close x 1.01 (proxy: VIXY); (3) gap_side_075: open vs prior close in (0%, +0.75%] for calls, [-0.75%, 0%) for puts; (4) calm = all three. Calls and puts both run (1)-(4). Puts also run the mirrored regime: VIXY percentile >= 60% and VIXY's last 1-minute close >= its prior close x 1.01. 66 runs, all counted as trials.

blocks.name: calm_regime
blocks.why: Unfiltered twin, each part of the calm regime, and all three together; calls and puts; 50/100 (0.50 delta) and 20/60 (0.45 delta). 60 runs.

blocks.name: mirrored_regime_puts
blocks.why: Puts only: VIXY percentile >= 60% and VIXY up at least 1% on its prior close (proxy: VIXY). Twin = the unfiltered put runs above. 6 runs.
